I created a small test program for this scenario.
Thank you for the clear explanation; this solution works for me! Much appreciated!

analysis.insight_summary: A user needed help capturing and showing an analog value on a display whenever a digital input condition was met. Following some initial confusion, another user quickly provided a solution, which the original poster confirmed worked. The thread highlights both the subtle technical details of connecting analog input logic to display triggers and the value of community support in solving such programming challenges.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to easily configure or program the system to save and display the latest analog value whenever a designated digital input is active, with a simple and effective setup.
